data.body: Fix implemented and validated (pre-push). Change: (1) _diff_comments compare_body now derives the LOCAL dedup key as _normalize_comment_body(codec.to_wire(_decorate_outbound_comment(sanitizer.fit_comment(body)))) — the one-decoder form: predict the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode, matching acli_cli_ops.add_comment) and decode it through the SAME _normalize_comment_body the Jira-side key uses. (2) _IdentityCodec gained a to_wire identity so the identity default keeps its no-op semantics. (3) Docstrings (module, _resolve_codec, _diff_comments) updated to describe the to_wire-based derivation. Send path untouched. RED→GREEN: 3 new tests in test_comment_dedup_key_matches_send_fit.py (in-limit markdown dedup under cloud cutover; genuinely-new markdown still emitted, parametrized off/cloud; over-length markdown truncation-notice facet) — capture-from-real-send-path pattern, only _run_acli stubbed. Both new dedup tests failed pre-fix (duplicate mutation emitted), all 12 pass post-fix; mutation check (old expression seeded back) turns them RED again. Validation: 479 tests across diffing/, length-convergence (cloud+DC), rich_text_codec, backend_neutrality, acli_comment_adf_encode, comment enrichment/inbound-diff, dc_comment_ceiling all pass; make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS (619 files); complexity ratchet new=0 increased=0 (1 allowed stale); module 605 LOC < 800 cap. Live repro re-run post-fix: mutations emitted over already-landed markdown body = 0 (was 1). Next: commit + Gerrit push.
